verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at docs.cdp.coinbase.com/llms.txt indexing 516 doc pages. The x402 docs are also served as raw Markdown (.md), and each page points agents to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: an x402-specific llms.txt (the index is CDP-wide), a discoverable OpenAPI spec at the docs host (all candidate paths 404), and independent or hands-on evidence of an agent consuming these docs end to end.
